The '''MRD-39B assassin droid''' was a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] that was developed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. They were [[Color/Legends|black]] in color and had six legs, each of which contained a different weapon. However, while the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were originally intended to be disposable, their design became complicated and they cost 20,270 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each to manufacture, and due to their price, the CSA considered them to be less expendable than organic operatives. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an MRD-39B droid was dispatched to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Republic [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Klieri]], inside her apartment in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].
